subtitles.en: There's always a lot on the minds of voters, and this critical midterm is no exception.
subtitles.zh: 选民们总是关心很多议题，这次关键的中期选举也不例外。

subtitles.en: But one issue is cutting across party lines, touching upon the economy, environment, and possibly the future of humanity.
subtitles.zh: 但有一个议题跨越党派界限，涉及经济、环境，甚至可能影响人类未来。

subtitles.en: All we've heard about is how big AI will be. Growing in the United States at least for now is this mimbyism and this pushback to data centers getting constructed.
subtitles.zh: 我们听到的都是AI将有多大规模。至少目前在美国，增长的是这种邻避情绪和对数据中心建设的抵制。

subtitles.en: Pull after pull after pull shows that there's a lot of anxiety among the general population about AI and what it's going to mean for their futures, fear of job loss, fear of a loss
subtitles.zh: 一次又一次的民调显示，普通民众对AI及其对未来意味着什么充满焦虑，担心失业，担心失去

subtitles.en: of autonomy. There's these bigger existential anxieties about the elite imposing technologies on the
subtitles.zh: 自主权。还有这些更大的存在性焦虑，关于精英将技术强加给

subtitles.en: rest of us. And it's coinciding with this populist undercurrent that is defined these midterms.
subtitles.zh: 我们其他人。这与定义此次中期选举的民粹主义暗流相吻合。

subtitles.en: This is outside the open AI offices.
Hey, I want you going to sell your politicians.
subtitles.zh: 嘿，我想让你去说服你的政客们。

subtitles.en: Leadership on the issue has been scattered and divided. This is self-regulation.
subtitles.zh: 该议题上的领导力一直分散且分裂。这是自我监管。

subtitles.en: Regulatory employees. We're leading China in AI and that's where I want to keep it going because whoever wins AI wins.
subtitles.zh: 监管雇员。我们在AI领域领先中国，我想继续保持下去，因为谁赢得AI谁就赢得一切。

subtitles.en: This is the largest industrial revolution in history. We only do work together called for local cooperation across the world between governments
subtitles.zh: 这是史上最大规模的工业革命。我们只做需要全球各国政府合作的工作，以制定国际标准。

subtitles.en: to set international standards. Where is AI going to go?
en_highlights: Where is AI going to go

subtitles.en: I don't know. I don't think President and CEOs really know.
subtitles.zh: 我不知道。我认为总统和CEO们也并不真正清楚。

subtitles.en: There's a fight right now over who writes the rules of AI. It's a battle over the soul of the AI industry.
subtitles.zh: 目前正有一场关于谁来制定人工智能规则的争斗。这是一场关乎AI行业灵魂的较量。

clip_research.source_claim: Big AI is pouring millions into the midterms, and voters across party lines are anxious about AI, data centers, and job loss.
clip_research.public_baseline: Public reporting documents AI-industry PAC spending in the 2026 midterms ranging from tens of millions to a claimed $300M+, and polling shows rising bipartisan opposition to nearby data centers.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The Chinese title's '数亿' (hundreds of millions) exceeds the $44M spent through June and the 'tens of millions' framing in most snippets; only one outlet claims $300M+, so the scale is contested rather than settled.

evidence.fact: Speaker says AI is pouring millions into midterms and cites voter anxiety about AI, data centers, and job loss.

evidence.query: AI political action committee midterms spending millions 2026
evidence.fact: Two largest AI PACs spent at least $44M through end of June from a war chest over $200M.

evidence.query: AI political action committee midterms spending millions 2026
evidence.fact: One outlet claims AI political spending topped $300M in 2026; single-source, treat as lead not proof.

evidence.query: AI data center opposition voters polls anxiety 2026 midterms
evidence.fact: Support for a nearby data center fell from 43% (2025) to 21% (2026) per Heatmap/Embold poll.
Student activists protested at OpenAI's DC office; separate Bellevue protest also documented.

forbidden_claims: That AI groups have definitively spent '数亿' (hundreds of millions) — only one outlet claims $300M+, others say tens of millions or $44M spent.
That OpenAI or Anthropic admitted wrongdoing or that the FTC probe found misconduct.
That the transcript's 'whoever wins AI wins' line is a Bloomberg editorial position.
That the protests represent a unified national movement.

notes: Clip 1 transcript is garbled (e.g., 'mimbyism', 'sell your politicians'); do not build claims on unclear fragments.
The '数亿' in the current Chinese title is not firmly supported; safer to say '数千万美元' or '巨额资金' unless the $300M figure is independently confirmed.
Bloomberg is the publisher/host, not an opinion-holding actor; attribute claims to the on-screen speakers.
No China-advantage comparison is substantiated in this clip despite the 'leading China in AI' fragment.

results.snippet: Flo Crivello, founder of AI assistant Lindy, described the ceaseless race for the most sophisticated AI as overserving the needs of many. He hasn’t looked back since ditching Anthropic for DeepSeek in June, slashing AI spending by 90%, saving millions of dollars that can be spent on headcount, marketing and an off-site event in California’s scenic wine region of Napa Valley. “You do not need God to write your emails,” he said.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
